title: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2610.20172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. translated_title: MultiPartyTurnBench：多方口语对话中的话轮控制基准测试
translated_abstract: 全双工语音系统必须决定何时进入、保持或放弃对话的话轮权，即使多个说话人出现重叠发言或仅做伴随反馈而不夺取话轮。现有的评估工作要么研究双人话轮转换，要么研究端到端智能体行为，但在多方场景中缺乏针对真实话轮转移与易混淆非事件之间的统一、受控的评估。我们提出了MultiPartyTurnBench（MPTB），这是一个包含240段合成生成、信道分离对话的基准，涵盖2至5个说话人以及6种交互类型。MPTB评估两个互补任务：话轮结束（EOT）检测，用于区分真正的话轮完成与临时停顿；以及打断（INT）检测，用于区分成功的话轮接管与非夺取话轮的言语。精确的事件条件标注使得能够采用误报约束召回率和带符号延迟进行因果评估。在声学、语义和话轮投影基线（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MPTB是首个针对多方口语对话中话轮控制的统一受控基准，通过240段信道分离、涵盖2至5个说话人的合成对话及精确事件标注，系统评估了话轮结束检测与打断检测任务，实现了对真实话轮转移的因果评估。
